name: spacefast
description: Publish files and folders to Spacefast from Claude Desktop. Permanent URLs, immutable versions, anonymous publish with a claim link.
long_description: Spacefast is the static host where AI-made things are kept. This extension connects Claude Desktop via the official Spacefast CLI MCP server, giving Claude tools to publish local files and run OpenAPI-generated operations in Spacefast's resumable QuickJS sandbox.

api_token.title: Spacefast API token
api_token.description: Your Spacefast account token (from spacefast.com/account/tokens). Leave blank to publish anonymously.

tools.name: execute
tools.description: Run JavaScript against the OpenAPI-generated Spacefast catalog in a secure sandbox

tools.name: skills
tools.description: Fetch a named how-to skill. Skills hold the long-form guidance that would otherwise bloat another tool's always-loaded description

tools.name: resume
tools.description: Resume a paused execution using the executionId returned by execute

tools.name: publish
tools.description: Publish one local path or an inline file set to Spacefast. On-Device MCP keeps anonymous credentials in workspace state and never asks the model to carry them
